open CategoryTheory in
theorem lg_target {C : Type*} [Category C] {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [Mono f] [Mono g] : Mono (f ≫ g) := by
  intro h₁ h₂ h_comp
  have : (f ≫ g) ∘ h₁ = (f ≫ g) ∘ h₂ → g ∘ h₁ = g ∘ h₂ :=
    by rintro (eq : (f ≫ g) ∘ h₁ = (f ≫ g) ∘ h₂)
       rw [comp_assoc] at eq
       exact eq
  have : g ∘ h₁ = g ∘ h₂ → h₁ = h₂ :=
    by rintro (eq : g ∘ h₁ = g ∘ h₂)
       exact mono_of_comp_eq g h₁ h₂ eq
  exact this h_comp
